sources.snippet: The final XGBoost model hit 0.96 accuracy and 0.99 AUC, which actually beat the public benchmarks for this dataset. The coolest part is the explainability. We used SHAP to break down exactly why the model flagged a patient as high risk, surfacing the top 15 risk drivers for the clinical staff so they aren't just looking at a black box number.

sources.title: Machine learning for hospital readmission prediction in pediatric ...
sources.snippet: Conclusion Machine learning approaches, especially XGBoost, can predict potentially avoidable 30-day pediatric hospital readmission into tertiary assistance. If implemented in the computer hospital system, our model can help in the early and more accurate identification of patients at readmission risk, targeting health strategic interventions.

sources.title: Hospital Patient Readmission Prediction using XGBoost - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project demonstrates a complete end-to-end machine learning pipeline for predicting hospital readmissions using XGBoost. It combines predictive modeling, explainable AI, and deployment-ready components to create a practical solution for healthcare analytics.
